_comment: Advisories accepted for a limited time. Each needs a reason, an owner and an expiry (YYYY-MM-DD). scripts/audit-gate.mjs fails CI on any high/critical advisory not listed here, and on any listed entry past its expiry. Review at every release.

advisories.reason: Pulled in by Expo CLI tooling for local dev certificates; not shipped in the app bundle or the API, and not used to verify signatures. No fixed release published yet.
Moderate. Via query-string in expo-router; the fixed release is ESM-only and breaks the CommonJS query-string the router needs. Revisit on the next Expo SDK.
Dev-only: used by the prisma CLI to merge its own config file. Not in the API runtime.

Fixed only in zod 4.6.6+, a breaking major upgrade for every shared schema (API, web, mobile). Mitigated: JSON bodies are capped at 256 KB on all routes except the four upload routes (8 MB), whose schemas have no unbounded collections; measured worst case at the cap ~24 ms / 7 MB per request, plus per-route rate limits. Migrate to zod 4 on a branch with the full test suite.
